title: Russell US Style indexes — Q4 conditional quarter-end recapping effective at the open (24% / 4.8%-above-48% test struck on the 2026-12-28 close), the year-end instance
source: EST: owner-published, read direct this session from two documents. (1) FTSE Russell, "Frequently Asked Questions -- Russell US Equity Indexes", July 2026 (ftse-faq-document-russell-us-equity-2026.pdf, HTTP 200, 198,134 bytes, 19 streams inflated 2026-09-08). Its dated four-column schedule table's DECEMBER 2026 column reads verbatim "Russell US Style Quarter-end Capping Cut-Off Date | 28 December 2026" and "Russell US Style Quarter-end Capping Effective Date (open of, if applicable) | 31 December 2026". (2) FTSE Russell, "Capping Methodology Guide", v5.4, September 2026 (capping-methodology-guide.pdf, HTTP 200, 652,008 bytes, 62 streams inflated 2026-09-08), which states the standing rule -- reference date "T-3", effective "Last business day in Mar, Jun, Sep and Dec", trigger "No company is greater than 24%, and all companies that have a weight greater than 4.8% in aggregate are no more than 48% of the index", scheme "RIC 22.5/45". THE STANDING RULE REPRODUCES THE PUBLISHED DECEMBER DATES EXACTLY, and this is the holiday-aware case that makes the check worth stating: the last business day of 2026 is Thu 31 December, so T-1 is Wed 30 December, T-2 is Tue 29 December and T-3 is Mon 28 December -- stepping over Christmas Day (Fri 25 December) -- which is the owner's own published cut-off to the day. Filed estimate for the same reason as every entry in this family: the confirmed-tier prefixes have no member for an index owner's own published methodology, this lane may not self-confirm, and the FAQ carries "NOTE: Dates may be subject to change. Clients will be notified of any changes." Conditional by construction -- the guide says "If no breach is identified, no changes are made." Discovered during the russell-style-quarter-end-capping-effective-2026-09-30 initial research, checked 2026-09-08
notes: PROPOSED by the russell-style-quarter-end-capping-effective-2026-09-30 initial research (2026-09-08). WHY THIS INSTANCE WAS FILED WHEN THE SIBLING LANE DECLINED TO FILE MORE INSTANCES OF ITS OWN CLASS, stated so a later lane does not read it as an oversight: the russell-quarterly-ipo-review-effective-2026-09-21 research declined the next quarterly IPO leg because it had MEASURED that class as an index-level null and more instances would spend board attention on nothing. This class is different in a way that research established rather than assumed -- the mechanism is live, it sits behind about $294.6B of iShares assets across the eight funds the iShares Trust SEC Form 497 names as tracking capped Russell US Style Indexes (IWF, IWD, IWY, IWX, IWP, IWS, IWO, IWN), and the Q3 test's breach probability was measured at 4.02% rather than zero (50 of 1,243 rolling 12-session windows over five years). A low-probability conditional on a live mechanism earns a calendar slot; a measured null does not. THE YEAR-END INSTANCE IS THE MOST CONCENTRATED OF THE FOUR and that is the specific reason to carry it: the Q4 quarterly capping review is the last reset before the test, mega-cap growth weights have run higher into each of the last several year-ends, and the same corridor carries the untracked S&P Select Sector Q4 test (proposed separately as sp-select-sector-secondary-reweight-2026-12-31.from-russell-style-quarter-end-capping-effective-2026-09-30.json) one session earlier, plus jpx-market-closure-2026-12-31, sifma-bond-early-close-2026-12-31 and china-retaliation-suspension-expiry-2026-12-31 already on the board. WHAT THE PROPOSING RESEARCH'S VERDICT WAS, travelling with the proposal so nobody sizes this as tradable: stand aside on every horizon. The quarter-end check is a BACKSTOP behind the quarterly capping review scheduled weeks earlier, which resets the >4.5% cohort to 45% and cuts the breach probability roughly sevenfold (28.96% of windows without the reset, 4.02% with it); the single-name leg is dead by a wide margin (NVDA 16.38% in IWY against a 22.5% cap and a 24% trigger); and even a fired recap moves about 3pp of IWY's $15.94B, roughly $478M, across five mega caps that each trade multiples of that before lunch. Impact low and symbols deliberately EMPTY on the same measured grounds as the Q3 entry. Kind sector matches the family. NOT YET VERIFIABLE FROM THIS SESSION: whether the Q4 quarterly capping cut-off and review-effective dates (the reset that defuses this test) fall where the December column says -- they do in the FAQ table, but the December column's review is the semi-annual reconstitution rather than a quarterly IPO review, so the researching lane should re-read the schedule table rather than assume the September geometry repeats.
